svg.title: Composition of the Q4_K projection as nested updates
svg.desc: Within one nc-kc panel a staged weight panel wp feeds two independent output-group chains whose f32 state is loaded from Y, updated once per input block and stored to Y. One f32 update is magnified: a fresh i32 state is updated once per 32-input subtile, and only the completed i32 value with the min_term correction forms the f32 update. One i32 update is magnified for one output component: groups of four products form i16 partials, which are widened, reduced over all groups, scaled by w.sc[s] and added.
